decision: Make the runtime network internal, enforce app no-new-privileges, require a clean checkout, assert npm files are absent, and clean only resources with this run's ownership label

decision: Refuse pre-existing database/attachment volumes and verify ownership labels before mounting them
why: Docker volume create can return an existing same-named volume without applying new labels; cleanup labels alone would not prevent use of that data
result: Guard added before any container can mount either volume; reviewer recheck pending
